sections.section_title: Section C: Santoor Literature & Reading Comprehension

questions.instruction: Choose the correct option for each question based on your Santoor textbook chapters ('Braille', 'The Lagori Champions', 'A Journey to the Magical Mountains', 'The Old Stag', and 'Together We Can').

items.question: In the chapter 'Braille', who invented the tactile system of reading and writing for visually impaired people?
In 'The Lagori Champions', what is the main objective of the traditional Indian game of Lagori (Seven Stones)?
options: To pile up seven flat stones after knocking them down with a ball
To hit the ball with a wooden bat over a boundary line
To kick a football into the opponent's net
To run around chairs before the music stops
items.answer: To pile up seven flat stones after knocking them down with a ball

items.question: In 'A Journey to the Magical Mountains', what makes the mountains feel 'magical' to the young travelers?
options: The bustling shopping malls and highways
The breathtaking snowy peaks, waterfalls, and serene nature
items.answer: The breathtaking snowy peaks, waterfalls, and serene nature

items.question: In 'The Old Stag', why did the stag admire his antlers when looking at his reflection in the water?
options: He thought they were grand, majestic, and beautiful
He wanted to break them off
He thought they were too short and thin
He was trying to hide them from other animals
items.answer: He thought they were grand, majestic, and beautiful

items.question: What important moral lesson do we learn from the story 'Together We Can'?
options: Working alone is always better than working with others
Teamwork, cooperation, and unity help us overcome difficult tasks
We should never share our ideas with friends
Only the strongest person can solve every problem
items.answer: Teamwork, cooperation, and unity help us overcome difficult tasks

questions.instruction:
Read the short passage below carefully: 
Passage: 'Louis Braille was born in France. At a very young age, he lost his eyesight in an accident. Despite this hardship, he was eager to learn. He invented a special script of raised dots on paper so that visually impaired people could read by touching them with their fingers.' 
Now answer the passage-based questions and textbook questions below in 1 or 2 English words.

items.question: According to the passage, which European country was Louis Braille born in?
What feature of Braille paper allows visually impaired people to read using their fingertips?
In the story 'The Old Stag', which part of the stag's body actually helped him run fast when danger approached?
In the game described in 'The Lagori Champions', how many flat stones are stacked to form the tower?
From the chapter 'Together We Can', what eight-letter word means working together cooperatively as a group to solve a problem?
